! Title: Fixture uAssets filters
! uBO scriptlet syntax, which translate rewrites to AdGuard syntax.
example.com##+js(aopr, adblock)
example.com##+js(nowoif)
example.com##+js(rmnt, script, ads)
video.example##+js(set-cookie, consent, ok)
! A uBO scriptlet with no AdGuard equivalent: dropped as scriptlet.no-alias.
example.com##+js(hd-main)
! AdGuard scriptlet syntax passes through.
example.org#%#//scriptlet('abort-on-property-read', 'adblock')
! Raw JavaScript, allowed only because this list is trusted.
example.org#%#window.__adblock = false;
! Procedural cosmetics travel as advanced rules, not content rules.
example.com#?#div:has-text(sponsored)
example.com#@#.sidebar-ad
! An unbreak exception that folds into a surrogate as unless-domain.
@@||securepubads.g.doubleclick.net/tag/js/gpt.js$domain=news.example
! A global surrogate exception cannot fold: it is appended to janus.active.
@@||imasdk.googleapis.com/js/sdkloader/ima3.js
! badfilter disables a rule that came from the AdGuard fixture.
||tracker.example.com/track.js$script,badfilter
! An unmatched badfilter is dead weight and is reported.
||nothing.example^$badfilter
! A redirect whose resource name is a uBO alias.
||example.com/ima3.js$script,redirect=google-ima.js
